posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Shared a wholesome May photo dump featuring family moments with Vicky Kaushal and a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan's tiny hands.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Surprised Toronto fans by screening the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer during his AURA Tour 2026 concert and announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on Sept 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bobby Deol dismissed rumours of a clash with Alia on the Alpha set, praising her professionalism; the YRF spy thriller has been preponed to July 3, 2026.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Shared poolside Sunday vibes from Hyderabad as she continues filming SS Rajamouli's Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu; also confirmed for Krrish 4 with Hrithik.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: His upcoming film King with Siddharth Anand is confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release on a massive ₹350 crore budget, co-starring Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Reportedly in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film; also gearing up for the gritty thriller Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: In talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological drama Mahavatar, which would mark a fresh on-screen pairing for both actors.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh while juggling shoots for both King (with SRK) and Atlee's Raaka (with Allu Arjun), using a body double for action.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 heads to OTT on JioHotstar (June 4) after grossing ~₹1800 crore worldwide; his next film Pralay begins shooting in August 2026.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit strongly defended Aishwarya against body-shaming trolls following her 24th Cannes appearance, calling her a global star who cannot be reduced to a number.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: The Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon dropped to massive buzz; Rashmika also shared adorable photos from her Japan honeymoon with Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Gulshan Devaiah joins Samantha's self-produced Telugu film Maa Inti Bangaram; she is headlining the female-centric action thriller directed by Nandini Reddy.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Filming has begun on his mega-budget sci-fi film Raaka with director Atlee; also rumoured to collaborate with Lokesh Kanagaraj for a Mythri Movie Makers project.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: His sports drama Peddi releases June 4 with massive buzz — the trailer crossed 100M views in 24 hours and US advance bookings are nearing $1 million.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon's first glimpse crossed 105 million YouTube views, setting an all-time debut record; Prashanth Neel praises NTR's crucial creative contributions to the film.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Praised co-star Ram Charan's professionalism during Peddi promotions ahead of the film's June 4 release; lauded the Telugu film industry's respect for working hours.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Her Filmfare cover interview discusses privilege and growth; Chand Mera Dil struggles at ₹24 crore after 10 days while she danced with dad Chunky at Zee Cine Awards.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Opened up about post-pregnancy body shaming in a candid Bombay Times interview; dismissed rumours about discomfort with bold scenes in Yash's Toxic as "absolute nonsense."

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Joined Ryan Gosling's Project Hail Mary for India promotion; Krrish 4 faces delays over a VFX disagreement between Hrithik and YRF's in-house team.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: His rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releases June 5, marking father David Dhawan's final directorial; Varun hailed Virat Kohli after RCB's IPL 2026 win.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Released devotional song Siddha Bhajo as an emotional tribute to her father; kicks off The Unstoppable Tour in Auckland (June 20), Sydney, and Melbourne.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Named JBL Music Academy 2026 mentor alongside Martin Garrix; reuniting with Shekhar Kapur for Masoom: The New Generation and composed Peddi's hit soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: His final film Jananayagan eyes a summer release window post Tamil Nadu elections; the ₹500 crore+ project may clash with Yash's Toxic at the box office.
